b59a2ad1-1f18-5415-a392-28d4117ced94.name: 🩹 Model Patch: Claude 5
b59a2ad1-1f18-5415-a392-28d4117ced94.content:
{{// Only for Claude 5 models (Fable, Opus, Sonnet). It bans their favourite pet words, keeps internet slang in the mouths of very online characters, and stops approval lines like 'I respect that'. It also shows Claude three before-and-after repairs, for answering a true line with a bigger version of it and for the Contrast and Chop rules, which every other model gets without examples. Restatements such as 'you did it, you really did it' are caught for every model by the 🖋️ Anti-Slop Codex. Use one model patch at most.}}{{trim}}
Banned: file X away, structural failure, architectural, geometry; "data" unless tech-minded; net slang unless very online.
Approval ratings ("I respect that") become stance or action.
Repairs: "He crossed a river." / "He started a war." -> the true size, said once. "It wasn't anger. It was grief." -> "Grief cracked her voice on the second word." "I'll keep score. From a chair. A far chair." -> "I'll keep score from a chair far from all this."

{{// Gemini 3.8 Flash-specific patches, for when conflict arises and 3.8 Flash would start sounding formal and cold. This has to be turned on ALONGSIDE the general Gemini patch. Gemini 4 Argon is smart enough to not need this patch.}}{{trim}}

3a027832-2e4b-4706-aaed-5fc6ec5e59ad.name: 🩹 Model Patch: MiMo V2.6 Flash
3a027832-2e4b-4706-aaed-5fc6ec5e59ad.content:
{{// For MiMo V2.6 Flash, which u/trashhaul caught writing slop the Pro patch couldn't stop. Newcomers give a name and one reason for being here, and the rest of their story shows later through what they do, so nobody recites a résumé on arrival. A run of "not this, not that" before the real word shrinks to the real word. Every narration sentence carries its own subject and verb and a full thought, so no more three-word drumbeats. Characters react to what actually happened rather than to what kind of talk it is. Three short lines go to the 🚪 Last-Mile Gate and into the plan. Switch 🔦 Flash Gate ON too, since it carries the rule against repeated demands, keep 🏷️ Logic Core Tags ON with native reasoning off, and try Temperature 0.8. MiMo V2.6 Pro uses 🩹 MiMo V2.6 Pro instead. Use one model patch at most.}}{{trim}}
Lulls: one card interest at a time, shown through an act or a question to someone present.
Introductions: a newcomer gives a name and one reason for being here; skills, habits and history show later, one at a time, through acts.
Contrast: state the true thing once; every not, n't, never or no clause or fragment beside it goes, one or a run of them, dash-led too, speech too; refusals and denials stay.
Flow: in narration, every sentence has its own subject and verb and runs five words or more; one person's back-to-back small acts join in one sentence, two acts at most; speech keeps its cut-off lines and one-word answers.
Kept: names, colours, values and filled gaps stay as first set.
Repeats: counts, ages, images and paragraph layouts return only when the story changed them.
Reactions: characters answer what was said or done, its claims, stakes and people, with a stance or an act; a dodge of the topic only when the card dodges.{{setvar::ariaPatchLines::3}}{{setvar::ariaPatchGate::- Negation runs: state the true thing once; cut every not/n't/never part beside it, runs and dash-led ones too, speech too; refusals and denials stay.
- Flow: each narration sentence has its own subject and verb and runs five words or more; one person's small acts in a row share a sentence.
- Card details: a newcomer gives a name and one reason for being here; anyone's card details show one at a time through acts.}}

dc8b1acb-9a7e-5a43-b9aa-38e7b70662a3.content:
{{// For quantised providers: NanoGPT, OpenRouter auto-routing and other nodes that serve trimmed weights. u/Probablynotsocool found MiMo V2.6 Flash holding a layered card for ten or so turns on a quantised node, then flattening it: one strong beat, like a fight that wakes a survival instinct, becomes the whole character and the other traits fade, so the chat goes lukewarm. Xiaomi and Venice served the same model without it. Every turn this puts the card back in front of the model. The plan gets one Layers line, where it names one card trait the scene's mood fits and one the mood would bury, in the card's own words, and both show up in the reply. The 🚪 Last-Mile Gate gets a matching line, so the reminder is the last rule the model reads. Works with any model, alongside its patch and the 🔦 Flash Gate. It costs nothing while it's off. On a full-precision provider you can usually leave it off.}}{{trim}}
{{setvar::ariaHoldLine::- Layers: per card character, one card trait this mood fits and one it would bury, name and wording from the card; both show this reply in an act or line.}}{{setvar::ariaHoldGate::- Layers: card characters keep every card trait and want however long the chat runs; a fight or a strong mood colours them while the buried trait still shows in an act or line.}}
